prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright snowfield with bare trees under a pale sky, a wooden fence of normal height and a cabin with a standard-size door in the distance, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, THREE people standing close side by side, shoulder to shoulder in a single row, with just enough spacing that every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back far enough that all three are visible from head to toe, the whole row filling the width of the tall frame, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Pakistani man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful idol face with a small V-line jaw, bright expressive eyes and a straight nose, clean-shaven, light smoky eyeliner and glossy skin, smooth light-brown skin with a warm undertone, a gentle soft smile, soft pastel-pink hair styled in a layered wolf cut with curtain bangs, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large copper hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a tin small flared temple bell, a silver square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three mixed-metal bracelets. Extremely long stiletto nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful man, far beyond any real person. A massive V-shaped torso: enormously broad shoulders with capped, rounded deltoids, a thick heavy chest, a deeply carved six-pack abdomen narrowing to a comparatively small waist, huge thick arms with split biceps and horseshoe triceps, wide flaring lats, and powerful thick quads and diamond calves. Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
